original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 43 TPM Device structure and its security-sensitive vendor, version, descriptive and characteristic metadata against the owner-approved platform TPM definition.
original_method: Preserve existing evidence, collect complete raw Type 43 through protected read-only access, retain raw vendor/version/characteristic values, compare the exact schema to the approved TPM matrix, and optionally correlate read-only OS TPM identity without clearing, provisioning or exposing secrets.
manual_activity: The security/platform owner supplies the expected TPM Vendor ID, specification generation, firmware interpretation, characteristics and redaction policy; an operator verifies target identity and protected access.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS and SMBIOS identity
Expected Type 43 structure count and handles
Expected description, characteristics and OEM-defined policy
Security redaction and protected evidence policy
safety_requirements: Never clear, provision, own, reset or firmware-update the TPM
Do not extend PCRs or change BIOS security settings
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL before preserving evidence
Protect credentials, identifiers and security evidence
Never use password-in-command-line SSH or disable host-key verification
Do not invent a Type 43 status field or expose endorsement material
agent_execution_scope: Validate target and owner-approved Type 43 matrix
Collect complete Type 43 output through protected access
Parse Vendor ID, spec versions, firmware words, description, characteristics and OEM-defined data
Decode firmware words according to the declared TPM generation and owner/vendor rule
Optionally correlate approved read-only OS TPM metadata with strict redaction
Report discrepancies without TPM mutation or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve vendor/version/characteristic/OEM matrix and redaction policy
Resolve absent, disabled, duplicate or version-encoding ambiguity
Approve any OS TPM correlation and sensitive-field handling
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 43 selector matches the source, but grep hides all required fields and sshpass/disabled host checking weaken credential and target protection; source log clearing is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through protected access collect unfiltered Type 43, preserve raw bytes and validate Vendor ID, major/minor spec, both firmware words, description, characteristics and OEM-defined data; keep any runtime status correlation separate.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 43 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain; evidence-clearing boilerplate is not executed.

modernized_recommendation.status: TYPE43 SECURITY MATRIX AND VERSION-AWARE DECODING REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare the complete fixed-length Type 43 record with an approved matrix, preserving raw four-byte Vendor ID, both firmware words and characteristic bits before any TPM-generation-specific decoding or redaction.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact schema/version handling and secret-safe evidence while correcting V2's nonstandard presence/status fields.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A heading proves neither TPM identity nor version; OS TPM visibility/status may corroborate runtime state but cannot replace SMBIOS Type 43 metadata.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS metadata does not prove TPM attestation, PCR correctness, ownership, provisioning or measured-boot operation.

project_override_considerations: A Project may define absent/disabled behavior and vendor-specific firmware/OEM decoding, but must retain raw Type 43 bytes and the applicable TPM-generation rule. Runtime status is supplemental evidence only.
expected_evidence: Redacted SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS identity, timestamp and approved TPM matrix
Protected complete raw Type 43 output and exit status
Raw and decoded Vendor ID, spec versions, firmware words, description and characteristic bits
OEM-defined handling and exact field comparison
Optional approved OS TPM correlation separated from SMBIOS fields
No-clear/no-TPM-mutation/security audit and engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and selector consistently target SMBIOS Type 43 TPM Device. GPT V2's presence/status expansion is corrected from the official schema without changing the Master contract.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only comparison is deterministic once the owner provides the TPM field/version matrix, vendor decoding and security redaction policy.

review_improvement: Turns a TPM heading check into exact, version-aware Type 43 validation and corrects nonstandard presence/status fields while enforcing security evidence handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 43 firmware words change interpretation with the Major Spec Version, so matching printed version text without retaining raw values can validate the wrong encoding. Presence is inferred from a structure and runtime status belongs to separate TPM evidence; neither is a Type 43 data field.
